nav.vault.title: Browse project groups and check files out and in
nav.requests.title: Change requests (ECR): report a problem, propose a change
settings.title: Settings
settings.appearance.hint: Choose how TeamCraft Desktop looks. The distribution skins are dark.
settings.language.hint: The language of the menus and messages of this app. Your data – item names, comments, file names – is never translated.
settings.language.saved: The language changes when the app starts again.
empty.no_groups.editor: No project groups yet. Create one – you become its manager and add the others.
empty.no_groups.viewer: No project groups yet. CAD editors create them – ask a manager of a group to add you.
empty.group_empty: This project group has no items yet.
empty.group_empty.editor: Import an existing CAD folder or create a new item.
empty.group_empty.editor_web: Create a new item or import a BOM exported from your CAD program. TeamCraft Desktop imports a whole CAD folder.
empty.group_empty.viewer: The CAD editors of the group add its items; they show up here.
empty.group_empty.not_member: Only members of the group add items to it – ask a manager of the group to add you.
empty.no_checkouts: No check-outs. Check out a revision to change its files – it stays here until you check it in.
empty.no_checkouts.viewer: Nothing checked out – checking out needs the CAD editor role.
empty.nothing_to_review: Nothing to review. A change lands here when its author submits it and you are one of its reviewers.
empty.no_open_changes: No open changes. A change collects the revisions to release together; yours stay here until they are released or cancelled.
empty.no_open_changes.viewer: No open changes. CAD editors create changes – a change request of yours can become one.
empty.no_new_files: No new parts or assemblies in your working folder.
empty.no_new_files.get: Get a project group to copy its files here, then work on them in your CAD program.
empty.workspace_folder: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet. Check it out, save its CAD files here and check them in.
empty.workspace_folder.mine: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet. Save its CAD files here and check them in.
empty.workspace_folder.none: The folder is empty – the revision has no files yet.
empty.items.viewer: CAD editors create the items; you see the ones of your project groups here.
empty.viewer_note.title: Viewer account
empty.viewer_note: You can look at everything you may see and request changes. Editing – items, check-outs, changes – needs the CAD editor role: ask an administrator of this server.
